newsitem.title: USA: Marvel to auction off units.
newsitem.headline: Marvel to auction off units.

text.p: Marvel Entertainment Group Inc said on Tuesday that it intends to proceed with the auction of its units that it had outlined in its plan of reorganization to bring the comic book publisher out of bankruptcy.
This follows Toy Biz Inc decision not to merge with Marvel under a joint plan of reorganization, Marvel said.

Marvel said the auction process, which will be conducted with the assistance of the Blackstone Group, is intended to obtain the best and highest bidders for Marvel's publishing and licensing businesses and its 26.6 percent interest in Toy Biz; Fleer/Sky Box trading card subsidiary; and the Panini sticker subsidiary.
Marvel had proposed merging with Toy Biz in the reorganization, which was supported by Marvel's principal shareholder Ronald Perelman and its banks.
